decisions.reason: The source specifies a location for already-required decorative LED lighting but does not necessarily require a new component or BOM revision; the existing selected LEDs may provide the power-button lighting.
Required lighting around the power button necessarily adds an electrical circuit that the finalized wiring plan must cover.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Please reproduce the rendered colors and buttons, the logo along the bottom, the “Deck 1” and “Deck 2” labels, the lighting around the power button, and the back-panel design and font.

wiring_plan_components: solenoid valve and station-button control circuit
value_updates.wiring_plan_content: include the approved solenoid valve dispensing controls and wiring for lighting around the power button
